entities.summary: Cedric De'Von Coward is an American professional basketball player for the Memphis Grizzlies of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Willamette Bearcats, Eastern Washington Eagles, and Washington State Cougars. He is the grandson of Maxie Parks.
